title: Be Strong, Little Hands
story: Be Strong and Don’t Give Up
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A man named Azariah came
With words from God above,
“The Lord is with you; seek Him out,
And you will find His love.”

[Chorus]
Be strong, be strong, don’t give up now,
Don’t let your hands grow weak,
For God rewards the good you do,
He’s found by those who seek.

[Verse 2]
So Asa kept on doing good
With hands both strong and true,
The people gathered, promising,
“And we will seek Him too!”

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes and rest your hands,
Tomorrow, do what’s right,
The Lord is close; He sees your heart,
And holds you through the night.

[Chorus]
mood: Walking music. A light, cheerful bounce steps under the voice like tired feet finding a second wind, matching Azariah's message that gave King Asa fresh courage to keep going. The chorus is bright and encouraging, a pat on the back set to a beat. By the last verse the bounce slows to a gentle amble and then a low, easy sway, as if the walk is done and the hands are folded for the night.
